**Conversation Overview**

The person requested a deep technical analysis of the Sina Finance news API system behind `https://tzxy.sina.com.cn/kuaixun`, a 7×24 hour global real-time financial news live feed page. The goal was to reverse-engineer and document all available APIs, their classifications, parameters, and response structures, then compile everything into detailed Markdown documentation.

Claude systematically investigated the API ecosystem using multiple approaches: reading a pre-existing skill file for baseline knowledge, fetching the target page HTML, conducting web searches for supplementary documentation, and attempting direct API calls via curl (which were blocked by network egress restrictions). Claude also successfully retrieved the official Sina iNews partner API documentation at `finance.sina.com.cn/inews/doc/develop.html`, which provided authoritative field-level specifications.

The final deliverable was a comprehensive Markdown report saved to `/mnt/user-data/outputs/sina_kuaixun_api_deep_analysis.md` covering three distinct API systems: the public Feed API (`zhibo.sina.com.cn/api/zhibo/feed` with `zhibo_id=152`), the official iNews partner API (`inews.finance.sina.com.cn/api/`) requiring appKey/appSecret MD5 signature authentication, and the unofficial real-time quote API (`hq.sinajs.cn`). The document includes complete parameter tables, full response field schemas, the complete `tag_id`/`typeid` classification mapping (0=全部 through 102=国际), the iNews PHP/Python signing algorithm, anti-crawling countermeasures (Referer spoofing, GBK encoding handling), production-ready Python code for incremental polling collectors and stock quote parsers, and deployment recommendations including polling frequency guidelines and storage schemas.

## 分析总结

### 三大 API 体系

**① 直播流 Feed API**（最常用，无需 Key）

```
GET https://zhibo.sina.com.cn/api/zhibo/feed
    ?zhibo_id=152&tag_id=10&dire=f&pagesize=20&id={游标}
```

返回 JSON，核心字段是 `data.feed.list[]`，用 `max_id` 做增量游标，每 30-60 秒轮询一次安全可用。

**② iNews 官方合作 API**（最稳定，需申请 appKey）

官方接口位于 `inews.finance.sina.com.cn/api/`，提供 `live7x24`（快讯详情）和 `live7x24_list`（快讯列表）两个快讯核心端点，还包含 `article`/`article_list`（长文资讯）、`subject`（专题）、`zhongce`（众测）等8个接口。鉴权使用 `appKey + appSecret` 的 MD5 签名机制。

**③ 行情 API**（非官方，逆向获取）

新浪官方从来没有对外发布过这个 API 接口，它是依靠社区力量一步步被破解出来的，没有官方文档，随时可能改格式、加限制甚至停更。
